text_to_image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate ONE completely new fictional adult male character from this written casting brief. This is an original casting design, not an edit and not a recreation of any prior photographed person. Face anatomy and proportions must follow the NEW facial design below. Retain the subtle personality of the archetype without defaulting to a generic handsome actor face. Highly realistic portrait with genuine everyday individuality, natural asymmetry, pores and fine vellus hair, no beauty filter. Bright soft frontal studio light, generous fill, low shadows, subtle restrained optical halation, realistic 50mm perspective, shallow depth of field but both eyes sharply focused. Solid pure white #FFFFFF seamless background across entire frame, no gradient, no scene, no props. Vertical 2:3 composition, complete head with white breathing room above hair, entire shoulders and arms included horizontally, half-body down to waist, upright head and torso facing camera, direct eye contact, arms relaxed. Natural clothing texture. No text, no logo, no watermark, no collage. Output one independent full-resolution photograph. Casting brief: A 24-year-old East Asian man with soft straight black curtain fringe, off-white tee, reserved warm half smile. NEW facial design: compact square face, softly full cheeks, wider-spaced almond eyes with visible subtle double eyelid creases, thick curved brows, small round nose and low bridge, broad lips with a shallow Cupid's bow, strong short chin. Natural everyday appeal.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。
